 SPEAK UP: J-pop Takuya Kimura stages shows, K-pop Lisa drops new docu. (2/2) 木村拓哉開唱、Lisa新推紀錄片（下）
 Add TT as Preferred Source 
 A: Japanese superstar Takuya Kimura is finally touring Taiwan for two shows at the Taipei Music Center. He’s also celebrating his 54th birthday today.
 B: Kimura has been a dominant force in the Asian showbiz for years, but he’s never held a solo concert overseas. This will be his first time.
 A: And his wife, singer Shizuka Kodo, just toured Taipei last month. It seems that the couple really adore Taiwan.
 Japanese superstar Takuya Kimura visits Taiwan last year. 日本天王木村拓哉去年訪台。
 Photo: CNA 照片：中央社
 B: Which other foreign artists are coming to Taiwan soon? 
 A: Japan’s Tomohisa Yamashita, South Korea’s Jung Eun-ji, girl group Le Sserafim, US band Culture Wars, and K-pop orchestral concert “SM Classics Live” are all coming this weekend.
 A: 日本天王木村拓哉終於來台巡演啦，今天和明天在北流連唱兩場，以慶祝今天54歲生日！
 B: 木村風靡亞洲許多年，從未在海外舉辦個人演唱會，這可是第一次。
 A: 而他的歌手妻子工藤靜香上月底才剛訪台，他們夫妻倆
 真愛台灣。
 B: 最近還有哪些藝人來台開唱？
 A: 日星山下智久、韓星鄭恩地、韓團Le Sserafim、美團文化戰爭、K-pop管弦音樂會「SM Classics Live」……本週末都會來台演出。
 （By Eddy Chang, Taipei Times／台北時報張迪）

 Taiwan is home to a beautiful wild feline: the leopard cat. Known locally in Mandarin as shih?, which translates to “stone tiger,” this elusive animal is Taiwan’s only surviving native wildcat. Although similar in size to a domestic tabby and easily mistaken for an ordinary housecat, the leopard cat ranks among the apex predators in Taiwan’s lowland ecosystems.

Despite its ecological importance, the leopard cat is facing a severe survival crisis. In Taiwan, it is classified as an endangered species, with only an estimated 500 to 700 individuals remaining in the wild. Most of the surviving population is concentrated in the low-altitude hills of Miaoli, Taichung and Nantou counties. 
The greatest threat to the leopard cat is habitat loss and fragmentation caused by human development, including the construction of roads, golf courses and residential areas. As their territory becomes increasingly fragmented, leopard cats are often forced to cross busy roads in search of food or suitable habitats.

 BOOKMAN BILINGUAL 雙語書林: The Dos and Don’ts of English 英語的對與錯
 2026-11-09 
 1. 他的健康已有好轉。 
ˇ His health has taken a turn for the better. 
χ His health has taken a turn for better. 
註：to turn/change for the better/worse, a turn/change for the better/worse 都是慣用語。 
2. 徑賽次序如下： 
ˇ The order of track events is as follows: 
χ The order of track events is as follow: 
註：不論主詞是複數或單數，「如下」都用 as follows，不用 as follow。例如： 
The program is as follows. 
The items are as follows. 
也可以說： 
The items follow. 
The program follows. 
The following is the program. 
The following are the items. 
3. 要做到這一切，精通商用英語是極有必要的。 
ˇ For this, a good command of business English is more than necessary. 
χ For these, a good command of business English is more than necessary. 
註：總結上文時，「這一切」應說 for this，不說 for
